title: 分级 · 高中｜叙事描写与应用写作 · 60 句
description: 人物行动、环境、转折、书信和倡议；拓展虚拟条件、分词结构、强调与倒装。

items.zh: 她说话时不断看向门口，仿佛还在等什么人。
items.en: She kept glancing towards the door as she spoke, as though waiting for someone.
answers: She kept glancing towards the door as she spoke, as though waiting for someone.
items.notes: glance：瞥看；as though doing：仿佛在做。

items.zh: 他没有急着纠正我，而是让我把想法说完。
items.en: Rather than correcting me immediately, he let me finish explaining my idea.
answers: Rather than correcting me immediately, he let me finish explaining my idea.
items.notes: rather than doing：没有先做；let someone do：让某人做。

items.zh: 听到自己的名字时，她握紧了手里的纸。
items.en: At the sound of her name, she tightened her grip on the paper.
answers: At the sound of her name, she tightened her grip on the paper.
items.notes: at the sound of：听到……时；tighten one's grip：握紧。

items.zh: 直到他把椅子搬到旁边，我才发现自己一直站着。
items.en: I did not realise I was still standing until he brought a chair over.
answers: I did not realise I was still standing until he brought a chair over.
I didn't realise I was still standing until he brought a chair over.
items.notes: not ... until：直到……才……。

items.zh: 尽管衣服沾满了泥，他仍小心地捧着那本干净的书。
items.en: Though his clothes were covered in mud, he held the clean book with care.
answers: Though his clothes were covered in mud, he held the clean book with care.
items.notes: though 表让步；with care：小心地。

items.zh: 她试图显得轻松，但颤抖的声音暴露了紧张。
items.en: She tried to appear relaxed, but her trembling voice betrayed her nerves.
answers: She tried to appear relaxed, but her trembling voice betrayed her nerves.
items.notes: betray 在此表示不经意地暴露；trembling：颤抖的。

items.zh: 他留在门边，给我们足够的空间自己处理。
items.en: He stayed by the door, giving us enough space to handle it ourselves.
answers: He stayed by the door, giving us enough space to handle it ourselves.
items.notes: 现在分词短语说明行动产生的效果。

items.zh: 我原本以为她会责备我，她却先问我有没有受伤。
items.en: I had expected a scolding, but her first question was whether I was hurt.
answers: I had expected a scolding, but her first question was whether I was hurt.
items.notes: had expected 表示先前预期；whether 引导表语从句。

items.zh: 他把最后一把干椅子让给了等候的老人。
items.en: He offered the last dry chair to the elderly person waiting nearby.
answers: He offered the last dry chair to the elderly person waiting nearby.
items.notes: offer ... to：把……提供给；waiting 修饰人。

items.zh: 她伸手接过盒子，像是在接一件易碎的珍宝。
items.en: She reached for the box as if accepting a fragile treasure.
answers: She reached for the box as if accepting a fragile treasure.
items.notes: reach for：伸手去拿；as if：好像。

items.zh: 走廊里只剩脚步声，让等待显得格外漫长。
items.en: Only footsteps broke the silence in the corridor, making the wait seem endless.
answers: Only footsteps broke the silence in the corridor, making the wait seem endless.
items.notes: break the silence：打破寂静；making 说明感受上的结果。

items.zh: 窗外的天渐渐亮了，我们却仍没找到线索。
items.en: Dawn was breaking outside, yet we had found no clue.
answers: Dawn was breaking outside, yet we had found no clue.
items.notes: dawn breaks：天亮；yet 表示转折。

items.zh: 远处响起的笑声突然使房间不再那么陌生。
items.en: Laughter in the distance suddenly made the room feel less unfamiliar.
answers: Laughter in the distance suddenly made the room feel less unfamiliar.
items.notes: make ... feel：让……显得；in the distance：在远处。

items.zh: 刚才还热闹的院子一下子安静了下来。
items.en: The courtyard, noisy a moment earlier, suddenly fell silent.
answers: The courtyard, noisy a moment earlier, suddenly fell silent.
items.notes: 插入形容词短语对照前后状态；fall silent：安静下来。

items.zh: 每当风吹动窗帘，我就以为有人进来了。
items.en: Whenever the wind moved the curtain, I thought someone had come in.
answers: Whenever the wind moved the curtain, I thought someone had come in.
items.notes: whenever：每当；had come 表示先于想法的动作。

items.zh: 雨水顺着玻璃流下，把外面的灯光模糊成一片。
items.en: Rain ran down the glass, blurring the lights outside.
answers: Rain ran down the glass, blurring the lights outside.
items.notes: blur：使模糊；现在分词表达伴随结果。

items.zh: 我们没有立刻回答，让那个问题在空气中停留了一会儿。
items.en: We did not answer at once, allowing the question to hang in the air.
answers: We did not answer at once, allowing the question to hang in the air.
We didn't answer at once, allowing the question to hang in the air.
items.notes: hang in the air：悬而未答；allow ... to：让……。

items.zh: 从山顶望去，熟悉的村子小得几乎认不出来。
items.en: Seen from the summit, the familiar village was almost too small to recognise.
answers: Seen from the summit, the familiar village was almost too small to recognise.
items.notes: seen from：从……看；过去分词的逻辑主语是 village。

items.zh: 喧闹声渐渐消失，我才听清他低声说的话。
items.en: As the noise faded, I could finally make out his quiet words.
answers: As the noise faded, I could finally make out his quiet words.
items.notes: make out：辨认、听清；as 表同步变化。

items.zh: 那扇我从未见它打开过的窗，那天开着，使我停住了脚步。
items.en: The window I had never seen open stood open that day, bringing me to a halt.
answers: The window I had never seen open stood open that day, bringing me to a halt.
items.notes: had never seen 表更早的观察；bring someone to a halt：使某人停下。

items.zh: 我伸手去拿奖状时，才发现上面写的是全组的名字。
items.en: Reaching for the certificate, I noticed that it named the whole group.
answers: Reaching for the certificate, I noticed that it named the whole group.
items.notes: reaching 的主语为 I；name 作动词表示列出名字。

items.zh: 钥匙就挂在门后，而我们已经在院子里找了半小时。
items.en: The key was hanging behind the door, while we had spent half an hour searching the yard.
answers: The key was hanging behind the door, while we had spent half an hour searching the yard.
items.notes: while 对照事实与先前行为；spend time doing。

items.zh: 正是她无意间的一句话，让我们重新检查了最初的假设。
items.en: It was her casual remark that made us reconsider our original assumption.
answers: It was her casual remark that made us reconsider our original assumption.
items.notes: it was ... that 强调真正触发转折的因素。

items.zh: 我正准备离开，那位一直沉默的同学叫住了我。
items.en: I was about to leave when the classmate who had remained silent called me back.
answers: I was about to leave when the classmate who had remained silent called me back.
items.notes: be about to ... when ...：正要……这时……。

items.zh: 让人意外的是，最初反对计划的人主动承担了最难的任务。
items.en: Unexpectedly, the person who had opposed the plan volunteered for its hardest task.
answers: Unexpectedly, the person who had opposed the plan volunteered for its hardest task.
items.notes: who had opposed：先前反对的人；volunteer for：自愿承担。

items.zh: 如果那张便条没有从书里掉出来，我们可能永远不会知道真相。
items.en: Had the note not fallen from the book, we might never have learned the truth.
answers: Had the note not fallen from the book, we might never have learned the truth.
items.notes: Had ... 省略 if 的过去虚拟条件倒装。

items.zh: 此前看似无关的细节，现在终于串联起来了。
items.en: Details that had seemed unrelated finally began to fit together.
answers: Details that had seemed unrelated finally began to fit together.
items.notes: fit together：互相吻合；过去完成时交代先前判断。

items.zh: 我以为任务已经结束，直到她拿出了第二个信封。
items.en: I thought our task was over until she produced a second envelope.
answers: I thought our task was over until she produced a second envelope.
items.notes: produce 在此表示拿出；until 引出转折节点。

items.zh: 回到起点时，我们才注意到出发时忽略的小标志。
items.en: On returning to the starting point, we noticed the small sign we had overlooked.
answers: On returning to the starting point, we noticed the small sign we had overlooked.
items.notes: on doing：一……就；had overlooked 表示之前遗漏。

items.zh: 故事最后，那把被嫌弃的旧伞成了大家最需要的东西。
items.en: By the end, the unwanted old umbrella had become what everyone needed most.
answers: By the end, the unwanted old umbrella had become what everyone needed most.
items.notes: what 引导表语从句；前后用途呼应。

items.zh: 我写信申请担任向导，希望把对家乡的了解用于接待工作。
items.en: I am applying to be a guide so I can use my knowledge of our town to welcome visitors.
answers: I am applying to be a guide so I can use my knowledge of our town to welcome visitors.
items.notes: apply to be：申请担任；so 引出目的。

items.zh: 你提到担心听不懂方言，我可以提前整理一些常用表达。
items.en: You mentioned concerns about the dialect; I can prepare some common expressions in advance.
answers: You mentioned concerns about the dialect; I can prepare some common expressions in advance.
items.notes: concerns about：对……的担忧；回应对方具体顾虑。

items.zh: 能否在活动安排中留出一小段时间，让学生介绍自己的作品？
items.en: Could the programme include a short slot for students to introduce their work?
answers: Could the programme include a short slot for students to introduce their work?
items.notes: slot：安排中的一段时间；for someone to do。

items.zh: 我愿意分享自己的方法，但它可能需要根据你的习惯调整。
items.en: I am happy to share my method, though it may need adapting to your habits.
answers: I am happy to share my method, though it may need adapting to your habits.
items.notes: need doing：需要被做；though 限定建议适用性。

items.zh: 由于车票已订好，我们想尽早知道活动是否改期。
items.en: With our tickets already booked, we would appreciate early notice of any change of date.
answers: With our tickets already booked, we would appreciate early notice of any change of date.
items.notes: with + 名词 + 过去分词交代既成情况。

items.zh: 你无需准备正式演讲，带来一个亲身经历的故事就好。
items.en: No formal speech is needed; a story from your own experience will do.
answers: No formal speech is needed; a story from your own experience will do.
items.notes: will do：就够了；降低邀请中的准备负担。

items.zh: 如果临时增加名额，我希望被考虑为候补讲解员。
items.en: Should an extra place become available, I would like to be considered as a reserve guide.
answers: Should an extra place become available, I would like to be considered as a reserve guide.
items.notes: Should 条件倒装；be considered as：被考虑为；reserve：候补的。

items.zh: 我们希望展览既能展示成果，也能让观众了解尝试的过程。
items.en: We hope the exhibition will show the results as well as the process of trying.
answers: We hope the exhibition will show the results as well as the process of trying.
items.notes: as well as 连接成果与过程两个目标。

items.zh: 今年的主题是否允许我们从家族故事出发，讨论更广泛的社会变化？
items.en: Would this year's theme allow us to explore wider social changes through a family story?
answers: Would this year's theme allow us to explore wider social changes through a family story?
items.notes: allow someone to do：允许某人做；through：通过某种叙事角度。

items.zh: 无论能否入选，这次准备都让我重新认识了自己的兴趣。
items.en: Whether selected or not, I have gained a new understanding of my interests through this preparation.
answers: Whether selected or not, I have gained a new understanding of my interests through this preparation.
items.notes: whether ... or not：无论是否；selected 指 I。

items.zh: 我们建议把旧校服交换安排在新学期开始之前。
items.en: We propose holding the uniform exchange before the new term begins.
answers: We propose holding the uniform exchange before the new term begins.
items.notes: propose doing：提议做；明确实施时点。

items.zh: 每位参加者都可以带走一本书，不必捐出同样数量。
items.en: Every participant may take a book without donating an equal number.
answers: Every participant may take a book without donating an equal number.
items.notes: without doing：不必以某行动为条件。

items.zh: 这次征集关注真实的校园故事，不要求情节特别曲折。
items.en: This collection seeks true school stories rather than unusually dramatic plots.
answers: This collection seeks true school stories rather than unusually dramatic plots.
items.notes: seek：征集；rather than 说明内容取向。

items.zh: 为了方便后来加入的人，我们会把讨论结果留在公共文档中。
items.en: We will keep the discussion outcomes in a shared document for anyone joining later.
answers: We will keep the discussion outcomes in a shared document for anyone joining later.
items.notes: for anyone doing：供后来做某事的人使用。

items.zh: 展板不仅介绍成功作品，也记录没能完成的尝试。
items.en: The display covers unfinished attempts alongside successful work.
answers: The display covers unfinished attempts alongside successful work.
items.notes: alongside：与……一同；cover：涵盖。

items.zh: 我们想请毕业生讲讲计划改变的经历，而不只是获奖经历。
items.en: We would like graduates to discuss changes of plan, not only their achievements.
answers: We would like graduates to discuss changes of plan, not only their achievements.
items.notes: would like someone to do；明确邀请分享的角度。

items.zh: 如果有人不愿公开署名，可以由主持人代读。
items.en: Anyone who prefers not to be named may have the host read their contribution.
answers: Anyone who prefers not to be named may have the host read their contribution.
items.notes: have someone do：请某人做；contribution：投稿内容。

items.zh: 讨论结束后，请写下一个被别人改变了看法的问题。
items.en: After the discussion, write down one issue on which someone changed your mind.
answers: After the discussion, write down one issue on which someone changed your mind.
items.notes: on which 引导定语从句；change one's mind：改变看法。

items.zh: 这项倡议的成效可以从实际使用情况观察，而不只看报名人数。
items.en: The initiative's impact can be observed through actual use, rather than registration alone.
answers: The initiative's impact can be observed through actual use, rather than registration alone.
items.notes: through 表示观察依据；initiative：倡议。

items.zh: 我们希望把活动留下的材料整理成下一届也能使用的资源。
items.en: We hope to turn the materials from the event into resources for next year's students.
answers: We hope to turn the materials from the event into resources for next year's students.
items.notes: turn ... into ...：把……变成……。

items.zh: 我终于明白，勇敢有时只是承认自己需要帮助。
items.en: I came to understand that courage sometimes means admitting a need for help.
answers: I came to understand that courage sometimes means admitting a need for help.
items.notes: come to understand：逐渐理解；means doing：意味着做。

items.zh: 那次相遇没有解决所有问题，却让我愿意继续尝试。
items.en: That encounter left many problems unsolved but renewed my willingness to try.
answers: That encounter left many problems unsolved but renewed my willingness to try.
items.notes: leave ... unsolved：让……仍未解决；renew：重新激发。

items.zh: 与其说我记住了他说的话，不如说我记住了他说话时的耐心。
items.en: I remember his patience more clearly than the words he used.
answers: I remember his patience more clearly than the words he used.
items.notes: more clearly than：比……更清楚，突出回忆重点。

items.zh: 后来每当看到那张照片，我都会想起大家等待彼此的样子。
items.en: Whenever I see that photograph now, I remember how we waited for one another.
answers: Whenever I see that photograph now, I remember how we waited for one another.
items.notes: whenever + 现在时，说明延续到现在的感受。

items.zh: 我没有成为自己想象中的领袖，却学会了让别人发挥作用。
items.en: I did not become the leader I had imagined, but I learned to make room for others.
answers: I did not become the leader I had imagined, but I learned to make room for others.
I didn't become the leader I had imagined, but I learned to make room for others.
items.notes: make room for others：给他人发挥空间；对照预期与收获。

items.zh: 那个答案并不复杂，难的是愿意重新提出问题。
items.en: The answer was simple; the difficulty lay in being willing to ask the question again.
answers: The answer was simple; the difficulty lay in being willing to ask the question again.
items.notes: lie in：在于；lay 是过去式。

items.zh: 如果只用名次衡量这次经历，我们就会错过其中最珍贵的部分。
items.en: Measuring the experience by rank alone would miss what mattered most.
answers: Measuring the experience by rank alone would miss what mattered most.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；would 表假设评价方式的后果。

items.zh: 我把那封信重新折好，这次没有急着放回抽屉。
items.en: I folded the letter again, this time without hurrying to put it away.
answers: I folded the letter again, this time without hurrying to put it away.
items.notes: this time 对照前后行动；without doing 表行为变化。

items.zh: 我们带回的不只是答案，还有值得继续问的问题。
items.en: We returned with answers and questions worth pursuing further.
answers: We returned with answers and questions worth pursuing further.
items.notes: worth doing：值得做；pursue a question：继续探究。

items.zh: 多年以后我才看清，那次小小的让步如何改变了我们的关系。
items.en: Only years later did I see how that small compromise had changed our relationship.
answers: Only years later did I see how that small compromise had changed our relationship.
items.notes: only + 时间状语置首，主句部分倒装；过去完成时表示更早变化。
